messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii**

| Month | Avg. high (°C / °F) | Avg. low (°C / °F) | Why it’s great |
|-------|---------------------|--------------------|----------------|
| **April** | 24 °C / 75 °F | 18 °C / 64 °F | Warm but not scorching, lower crowds after the spring break rush, and spring flowers bloom. |
| **May** | 25 °C / 77 °F | 19 °C / 66 °F | Pleasant beach weather, fewer tourists than summer, and many travel‑deal promotions. |
| **September** | 26 °C / 79 °F | 20 °C / 68 °F | Post‑summer crowds thin out, prices drop, and the weather remains sunny and comfortable. |
| **October** | 25 °C / 77 °F | 19 °C / 66 °F | Mild temperatures, great for hiking and outdoor activities, and the fall foliage adds color to the islands. |

### Bottom line
If you’re looking for a balance of good weather, fewer crowds, and better travel deals, **April, May, September, and October** are the sweet spots for visiting Hawaii. Summer months (June–August) are hot and busy, while winter (December–February) can bring occasional rain and higher prices for peak holiday travel.
